paper: CNN-generated images are surprisingly easy to spot... for now (CNNDetection). Wang, Wang, Zhang, Owens, Efros — CVPR 2020.
training_set_in_paper: ProGAN real-vs-fake across 20 LSUN object categories (airplane,bird,bicycle,boat,bottle,bus,car,cat,cow,chair,diningtable,dog,person,pottedplant,motorbike,tvmonitor,train,sheep,sofa,horse). Real=LSUN (0_real), fake=ProGAN (1_fake). Backbone = ImageNet-pretrained ResNet-50 fine-tuned end-to-end. Headline model = Blur+JPEG(0.5): Gaussian blur sig 0-3 p=0.5, JPEG q30-100 (cv2/pil) p=0.5, train loadSize=256 random-crop 224. README L96-100 (train cmds).

benchmarks.name: ForenSynths test set (CVPR paper Table 2 = 11 generators; released repo set = 13)

paper_number.note: Paper Table 2 reports per-generator AP for 5 augmentation variants over 11 generators (NO stylegan2 / whichfaceisreal). Headline Blur+JPEG(0.5) mAP over those 11 = 90.8 (per the prior PDF-derived spec). The README's released-set table (L123-139) adds stylegan2+wfir and reports BOTH a 224-center-crop column (paper protocol) and a No-crop column (recommended, higher). The task's loose '~91' / '~96-98' refer to this 224 vs no-crop spread.

paper_per_generator.note: ProGAN..DeepFake = paper Table 2; StyleGAN2/WFIR are repo-released additions. From README L123-139 (224 AP column) and the PDF-derived spec.

benchmarks.official_eval_protocol: eval.py runs over the 13 dirs in eval_config.py vals (L12-13) with model_path = weights/blur_jpg_prob0.5.pth (L19). Per-domain eval.py sets opt.no_resize=True (L21) -> NO resize. Crop: paper protocol = CenterCrop(224); the recommended alt is --no_crop --batch_size 1 (uncropped, README L115-119). multiclass flag (eval_config L16) marks progan/stylegan/cyclegan/stylegan2 as multi-subdir. Model resnet50(num_classes=1), state_dict['model'] (eval.py L23-25). AP via sklearn average_precision_score, acc@0.5 (validate.py L20-23).

our_number.note: AGID ForenSynths-13 mAP 91.05 ≈ official-vendored 91.15; AGID FS-8 94.42 ≥ official 92.67. Matches the paper's Blur+JPEG(0.5) headline ~90.8.

benchmarks.gap_cause: n/a — reproduced. AGID 91.05 (FS-13) ≈ official 91.15 ≈ paper Blur+JPEG(0.5) ~90.8. AGID uses tf_resize_crop(256,224,IMAGENET_MEAN,IMAGENET_STD) (registry.py:157) which adds a Resize(256) the official eval omits (no_resize=True); the effect is negligible at this match level (per-gen differences are mixed-sign, e.g. AGID biggan AP 94.05 vs official 88.24 but deepfake 72.84 vs 66.27). The AGID-trained checkpoint reproduces the official ResNet-50 rather than loading its weights.
benchmarks.dataset_source: on-disk /hddstore/ssalehi/AGID/CNNDetection/test (all 13 generators fully populated; counts in the prior PDF-derived spec). ProGAN-20 train+val also on disk under /hddstore/ssalehi/AGID/CNNDetection/{train,val}. Origin: HF sywang/CNNDetection (CNN_synth_testset.zip) or gdrive 1z_fD3UKgWQyOTZIBbYSaQ-hz4AzUrLC1; weights via weights/download_weights.sh.

summary: CNNDetection reports ONE main test benchmark (ForenSynths, paper Table 2: 11 generators x 5 augmentation variants; the released repo set adds stylegan2+wfir = 13). We reproduce it: AGID ForenSynths-13 mAP 91.05 ≈ official-vendored 91.15 ≈ paper Blur+JPEG(0.5) headline ~90.8; AGID FS-8 94.42 ≥ official 92.67. Nothing missing or below. Reproduced via an AGID-trained ResNet-50 (ckpt_kind=agid) matching the official blur_jpg_prob0.5.pth. Minor protocol note: official eval uses no_resize=True (paper = CenterCrop 224; recommended = no-crop); AGID adds a Resize(256) before crop, negligible at match level. The repo also exposes a Blur+JPEG(0.1) model (README L142-158) as a secondary variant.
